notes: Seed https://www.co.live-oak.tx.us/ loads; results are on the Results and Election History pages (scanned Electionware-style reports; read visually). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Last-Modified differs per file. Scanner PDF CreationDate values for the 2024 precinct files are later than their uploads (scanner clock wrong), so printed run times and Last-Modified are used. 2024: per-precinct unofficial reports uploaded one by one on election night (only 2 of 14 files fetched, at 9:36 and 10:37 PM). 2026 runoff: county cumulative only on election night. 2026 primary: no results found on the site; check 3 pending. Rule 47 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-47): none. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-G): found the 2026 primary results on the Election History page (missed earlier): an 'Election Night Results' county-totals report printed 11:03 PM on 3/3/2026 plus cumulative and early-vote reports, all scanned and uploaded 18 Mar 2026, and no precinct report. 2026_primary stays UNDETERMINED because no copy was online on election night (rule 47 analogue); if a printed election-night run time alone is accepted for LATER, this would be LATER and the tag would become COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS (lead for re-review). Wayback harvest: co.live-oak.tx.us CDX robots_disallowed_or_unreachable in all windows; a direct CDX query through the fetch module was refused the same way. Sweep: no sweep file. No change.
tag_rationale: 2024 general is LIVE (check 2) and 2026 runoff is LATER (check 2), with the primary undetermined; no two elections share a result, so the rule gives UNKNOWN. Rule 47 checked 2026-10-02: no change.

2024_general.fact: Results page lists one 'Unofficial Pct. N ... Results' PDF per precinct (14) plus 'Unofficial Cumulative Results'. Two precinct files read (scanned, read visually): Pct 11 Simmons 'Unofficial Results Pct 11 ... GENERAL ELECTION 11/5/2024 ... Run Time 9:20 PM' with Election Day Voting column (Trump 31 election day), Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 03:36:24 GMT (9:36 PM CST); Pct 2 Lagarto 'Unofficial Results Pct 2 ... Run Time 10:32 PM' (Trump 274 election day), Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 04:37:48 GMT (10:37 PM CST). Cumulative Last-Modified 04:45:31 GMT (10:45 PM CST). Precinct numbers were posted precinct by precinct in separate uploads at different times on election night. Rule 47: publication shown by upload time 2024-11-05 21:36 CT in SIMMONS.pdf and upload time 2024-11-05 22:37 CT in LAGARTO.pdf.

2026_primary.fact: Rule 43/47: no file posted on election night survives. The Election History page does list March 3, 2026 primary results: 'Early Voting Results', 'Election Night Results' (2026/Results/EN Unoffical Results.pdf), 'Cumulative Results-Democratic', 'Cumulative Results-Republican', 'Election Reconciliation - Official Totals'; no precinct report. 'Election Night Results' is a 19-page scan (read visually from the page image): 'Cumulative Results Report ... Election Night Results ... Run Time 11:03 PM Run Date 03/03/2026 ... LIVE OAK COUNTY, TEXAS PRIMARY ELECTION 3/3/2026 ... Unofficial Results ... Precincts Reporting 14 of 14', county totals by Absentee, Early and Election Day; scan CreationDate 2026-03-18 20:44:39 UTC, Last-Modified Wed, 18 Mar 2026 20:45:18 GMT. All three result files were scanned and uploaded 18 Mar 2026, so they do not show what was posted on election night.
